exposure: caesarean section due to medical indication
cohort: 372 women who gave birth to their first child in Sweden
finding: Women who had a vaginal birth, instrumental vaginal birth, or planned cesarean section reported better HRQoL five years postpartum compared to those who underwent an emergency or medically indicated cesarean section.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was associated with differences in HRQoL five years after birth, with emergency or medically indicated cesarean section being associated with lower HRQoL.
